description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the EmployeeClaimRequestAPI related to Employee Claim Requests within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes setup methods, data providers, and test cases for creating, retrieving one, and retrieving all employee claim requests.

classes.name: EmployeeClaimRequestAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing EmployeeClaimRequestAPI functionalities such as create, getOne, and getAll for employee claim requests within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initial setup method to populate workflow state machine data before any tests run.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of an employee claim request through the API using different test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test case data for the 'testCreate' method from the specified YAML file.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single employee claim request by ID through the API for various scenarios.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test case data for the 'testGetOne' method from the specified YAML file.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all employee claim requests through the API for various scenarios.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test case data for the 'testGetAll' method from the specified YAML file.
